title: School Counseling Practices
tagline: The school is the front line of child mental health.
welcome: Most children meet a counselor only at school. This course prepares you to be that counselor: skilled, systemic, and present.
vignette: A school counselor's day: a suicidal disclosure at 8:40, a teacher consultation at 9:15, a parent call at noon, a classroom lesson at 1:00, and a grief group at 3:00. The role is vast. This course gives it structure and skill.
vignette_attr: A school counselor's day, drawn from practice
description: A course in the practice of school counseling with children and adolescents: the comprehensive school counseling model, classroom guidance, individual and group counseling in schools, consultation with teachers and parents, crisis response, college and career development, and ethical-legal issues in schools.
questions: How do I serve the whole school and the one child at once?
What is my role in the teacher's classroom?
How do I balance confidentiality with school safety?
importance: Schools reach nearly every child, including the unreferred
The school counselor is a mental-health first responder
Effective school counseling improves climate and outcomes
misconceptions: that school counseling is scheduling and discipline support, when it is a clinical and developmental profession
that individual counseling is the whole job, when the model is comprehensive
figures: whose comprehensive model organized the profession
whose mindset research informs guidance curriculum

closing: May every school you serve be safer and kinder because you are in it.
